instruction: Open /home/user/Desktop/final_benchmark.step and /home/user/Desktop/params.json in FreeCAD 0.21.2 Path/CAM. Before starting the work, use `/usr/lib/freecad/bin/freecadcmd-python3` for FreeCAD Path command-line automation. The STEP is the finished 180 x 100 x 18 mm part in machining coordinates X=-90..90, Y=-50..50, Z=-18..0. It contains three 34 x 24 mm rounded-rectangle pockets with R4 corners at centers (-55,15), (0,15), and (55,15), with floors at Z=-4, Z=-6, and Z=-8 respectively; sixteen ordinary D5 through holes at X=-70,-50,-30,-10,10,30,50,70 and Y=-32,-16; two D5 counterbore pilot through holes at (-78,38) and (78,38), each with a D12 counterbore floor at Z=-4; and one 44 x 10 mm planar surface region spanning X=-22..22, Y=33..43 with floor Z=-0.5. Create one editable native Path Job using G54 at the top-face center (0,0,0). Configure box stock X=-95..95, Y=-55..55, Z=-18..1. Add four independent editable fixture/check solids at the exact bounds in params.json; their inner X faces are at +/-102 mm. The physical swept envelope of the final D8 compensated outside profile reaches X=+/-98 mm, so each fixture has 4 mm horizontal clearance, and every operation must use SafeHeight 5 mm and ClearanceHeight 8 mm so the clearance plane is 4 mm above the fixture top Z=4. Use five distinct tools T1-T5 with five assigned machining roles: T1 D20 flat end mill for facing; T2 D8 flat end mill for all three pockets and the final profile; T3 D5 118-degree drill for all eighteen pilot axes; T4 D10 flat end mill for native Helix counterboring; and T5 D6 ball end mill for native Surface finishing. All five ToolControllers must use forward spindle S7000 rpm and horizontal and vertical feed F500 mm/min. Keep exactly eight active native operations in this order: MillFace from stock Z=1 to final Z=0; three PocketShape operations to Z=-4,-6,-8 using 2 mm StepDown and 50% stepover; one Drilling operation with the eighteen unique axes, nominal FinalDepth -20 mm, RetractHeight 2 mm, Drill Tip extra offset, and G98 safety retraction; one Helix operation machining both D12 counterbores from Z=0 to Z=-4 with T4; one planar ZigZag single-pass Surface operation on the specified region using 1 mm sample interval, zero DepthOffset, and 25% stepover; and one clockwise compensated Outside Profile to Z=-18 using 3 mm StepDown, with holes and circles excluded. Post through the native linuxcnc postprocessor. Write /home/user/Desktop/task-20.nc, save the editable recomputable native document as /home/user/Desktop/task-20.FCStd, and write /home/user/Desktop/post_log.txt containing the actual FreeCAD version/commit, postprocessor/WCS, total operation count, native operation states and command counts, captured initial and fresh-repost output, captured warning/error count, SHA-256 file hashes, and reopen/recompute/repost result. For each operation, include exactly one log row with its native Proxy module, tool number, state, and command count. After closing and reopening the FCStd, all eight paths must remain non-empty and Up-to-date, and a fresh native repost must match the submitted NC apart from volatile timestamp text.
